searchText: Wohoo, Besu fix is in and all devnet-7 nodes are now back on the same head: https://forkmon.4844-devnet-7.ethpandaops.io/ 😄 let the blob spamming commence again! I updated tx-fuzz and started spamming devnet-6 and I found this: ``` Jul 11 14:14:24.042 DEBG Successfully verified gossip block root: 0x5d9046f2230e9c7f24d69fbca3a45b9d21610f9500cedf5c6f33c91a7772d666, slot: 79867, graffiti: teku/besu, service: beacon Jul 11 14:14:24.042 INFO New block received root: 0x5d9046f2230e9c7f24d69fbca3a45b9d21610f9500cedf5c6f33c91a7772d666, slot: 79867 Jul 11 14:14:24.048 WARN Invalid execution payload method: new_payload, slot: 79867, proposer_index: 41, graffiti: teku/besu, root: 0x5d9046f2230e9c7f24d69fbca3a45b9d21610f9500cedf5c6f33c91a7772d666, execution_block_hash: 0xd7ab9f128c39a58d596f2e3c5f03f0a51659c446c8d92ac557f9b94e9117c5eb, latest_valid_hash: None, validation_error: None, service: beacon Jul 11 14:14:24.049 DEBG Failed to verify execution payload error: ExecutionPayloadError(RejectedByExecutionEngine { status: Invalid { latest_valid_hash: None, validation_error: None } }) ``` Looks like a block production issue in besu? another one: ``` Jul 11 14:17:12.081 DEBG Successfully verified gossip block root: 0x5503e546595b0ee103974adf68fbf723511297bf69b8064d4ccd50ce2ce7bccd, slot: 79881, graffiti: lighthouse/besu, service: beacon Jul 11 14:17:12.081 INFO New block received root: 0x5503e546595b0ee103974adf68fbf723511297bf69b8064d4ccd50ce2ce7bccd, slot: 79881 Jul 11 14:17:12.087 WARN Invalid execution payload method: new_payload, slot: 79881, proposer_index: 467, graffiti: lighthouse/besu, root: 0x5503e546595b0ee103974adf68fbf723511297bf69b8064d4ccd50ce2ce7bccd, execution_block_hash: 0x200bbf7cd706bb14447d5a91ad67f8cb4eef61293328085a62567f258a0300f6, latest_valid_hash: None, validation_error: None, service: beacon Jul 11 14:17:12.087 DEBG Failed to verify execution payload error: ExecutionPayloadError(RejectedByExecutionEngine { status: Invalid { latest_valid_hash: None, validation_error: None } }) ``` cc <@&836981603216654336> besu logs this is the error logged: ` validationError: Versioned hashes from blob transactions do not match expected values` this was on devnet6? running most recent build? probably a typo this is on devnet-7, but geth uses the devnet-6 branch name gotta keep it interesting 😄 It looks like you are only returning the last blobhash of a block as versionedHashes what is life without whimsy? lul https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/blob/3f2a0160a8a16c988bd939b36d30285cc680465a/ethereum/core/src/main/java/org/hyperledger/besu/ethereum/core/encoding/TransactionEncoder.java#L190C28-L190C28 wrong branch? https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/blob/4844-devnet-5b/ethereum/core/src/main/java/org/hyperledger/besu/ethereum/core/encoding/TransactionEncoder.java branch names are so obvious 😄 😄 to be fair we made it hard by relaunching with the same name 😛 Ah githubs search function tricked me again teku-geth: <@504202741933932544> and <@360491619402776577> This is another besu block that's geth rejecting the payload. We marked that beacon block as invalid i'll have 👀 on it asap, bout an hour or so So I did resubmit the deposits, but I think I'm waiting for them to be voted on? Not entirely sure. It's been ~4 hours which feels too long. `ETH1_FOLLOW_DISTANCE` is 12 blocks, but `EPOCHS_PER_ETH1_VOTING_PERIOD` is still 32 epochs.
